faqs.q: What residential electrical services do you offer?
faqs.a: Panel upgrades for your home's electrical capacity, wiring installations, repairs and upgrades, troubleshooting to find and resolve faults, lighting improvements tailored to each room, and EV charger installation. We also carry out safety inspections and code compliance work.

faqs.q: What does it cost to install an EV charging station at home?
faqs.a: The charger itself ranges from $300 to $700 for a Level 2 unit. Installation labor in the Houston area runs $200 to $1,000, an electrical panel upgrade where one is needed is $500 to $3,000 or more, permits add $100 to $300, and additional wiring and materials add roughly $100 to $500. In total a Level 2 installation comes to about $700 to $4,500, though a typical residential job falls within $500 to $2,500.

faqs.q: Do I need a dedicated circuit for my EV charger?
faqs.a: Yes. A Level 2 charger needs a 240-volt circuit, higher amperage than a standard household outlet, and sharing a circuit with other appliances risks overload and slower charging. Many local electrical codes in Houston require a dedicated circuit, so an electrician will usually run new wiring from your panel to the charger location.

faqs.q: How long does it take to charge an electric vehicle at home?
faqs.a: A Level 1 charger on a standard 120-volt outlet adds about 2 to 5 miles of range per hour, so a 200-mile EV can take 40 to 100 hours from empty. A Level 2 charger on a 240-volt circuit adds about 10 to 25 miles per hour, which is why it is the most common choice for a home.

faqs.q: What kind of lighting do you recommend for a home?
faqs.a: LED, for a few reasons. It uses significantly less electricity than traditional bulbs, it lasts up to 25 times longer than an incandescent bulb, it comes in a range of color temperatures with dimming, and it is more resistant to shock and vibration. We recommend recessed LED for ambient light, task lighting in kitchens and workspaces, accent lighting for architectural features, and outdoor LED for security and curb appeal.

faqs.q: How often does a generator need servicing?
faqs.a: A residential generator typically needs an annual inspection and service, including the occasional load test. Commercial units often need monthly or bi-monthly inspections and a load bank test at least once a year, which matters most in sectors like healthcare where NFPA standards apply.

faqs.q: Which generator brands do you install?
faqs.a: Cummins, Kohler and Briggs & Stratton, along with many others. Our technicians are trained to install and configure these brands so the generator works with your existing electrical system.
